messages:
cheng: CI just turned red on master — serializer_golden_test has 12 snapshot diffs after merge of PR #4821. Not sure if it's a real regression or a formatting tweak. @maya did your change touch prompt spacing? :thinking:
qa-ci-bot: Build 4821.3 failed on shard 7. Test failures: serializer_golden_test (12 diffs). Link: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/4821.3 · rerun available
maya: yes, that PR normalized prompt trailing spaces when rendering prompts for evals. I didn't expect it to touch serialized golden outputs but looks like the serializer embeds exact prompt text in the snapshot. Sorry — I can dig in. :grimacing:
oliver: quick triage checklist: 1) reproduce locally with the same commit range 2) try regenerate to see if diffs are intended 3) if intended, update goldens in the PR, otherwise bisect to find offending change. Who can run a bisect?
sam: I can reproduce locally. Running:
```
# checkout master at failing SHA
git fetch origin && git checkout origin/master
bazel test //tests:serializer_golden_test --test_output=errors --test_arg=--update_golds=false
```
Got same 12 diffs. Pasting a small diff:
```
- Prompt: "Summarize the following document.\n"
+ Prompt: "Summarize the following document.\n\n"
```
Looks like an extra blank line added to the prompt.
maya: ugh yeah that was the normalization — it adds a trailing blankline when templates end with newline. I can push a fix to the serializer to trim canonical prompt when embedding, or we can accept the new format and update goldens. Which direction do we want?
tara: preference is keep goldens stable where possible — if change is strictly normalization and not affecting model outputs, I'd rather change serializer to preserve previous behavior. But if the normalization is overall better we should update goldens + leave a changelog. Either way need a PR with a clear note. :memo:
cheng: can we bisect to confirm no other commits caused additional diffs? oliver, want to run a quick git-bisect between c3f2abc and a9b4ef2 and test serializer_golden_test on each step?
oliver: starting bisect now (will run tests with --test_arg=--update_golds=false so we only detect diffs).
```
git bisect start a9b4ef2 c3f2abc
# run test script that exits non-zero on diffs
./ci/run_golden_check.sh //tests:serializer_golden_test
```
(approx 6 iterations expected)
qa-ci-bot: Rerun request accepted. Spawning rerun for build 4821.4 on shard 7.
sam: while bisect runs, here's a quicker local regen if we decide to accept new spacing:
```
GOLDEN_UPDATE=1 bazel test //tests:serializer_golden_test --test_output=errors
# then commit the updated files under tests/golds/serializer/
```
maya: if we choose to change serializer behavior I'll open a fix PR and include a small test to prevent this regression in future. If we update goldens instead, I'll prepare a follow-up PR to update them and add a note in CHANGELOG.md.
cheng: reminder for PR etiquette: small follow-up PRs are fine but mark them with [golden-update] and include a test plan. If the bisect shows only my earlier PR is the cause, we can decide quickly.
oliver: bisect finished — culprit commit is maya's PR commit 8f7d2e1 (the template normalization). Confirmed with manual check.
sam: thanks. maya — either revert the normalization or make serializer robust to trailing blanklines. Which would you prefer?
maya: I'll open a fix to strip trailing blank lines only when embedding into goldens (so behavior for runtime remains unchanged). PR coming in ~30m.
tara: thanks. Once fix PR lands let's kick CI and confirm golden diffs are gone. If any remaining diffs show up, we can do a controlled gold update with clear rationale. :+1:
qa-ci-bot: Notification: job 4821.5 started (post-fix verification).
cheng: awesome — ping here when green and we'll merge. :eyes:
